notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/813e981d57d44bed5321b7a0580b12d3e7b520e8.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hey Shapers, 

We hope you've been gaming well! [/h3][p]
We've got a medium-sized update for you today featuring [i]Guardian Mode[/i], in-game balancing, changelogs, and a few community requests & bug fixes. 

If you're free this Friday, we've also got another [b][i]Shapers vs. \[Metric] Showdown[/i][/b] with prizes to be won. [/p][p]Let's get into it. [/p][p][/p][h3]🛡️ [b][i]Guardian Mode:[/i][/b][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/67973037803ce1fdc9c39a83ce2c19da6b65bbaf.png"][/img][/p][p]By popular demand, [i]Guardian Mode[/i] is a difficulty toggle designed to help players access the true ending of the game after defeating VerOs. This toggle option is located under the Gameplay Tab in the game's options menu. 

When enabled, players will receive incremental damage reduction starting from regular runs to Phantom Code difficulty levels. The approximate breakdown is as follows:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p] [b]Baseline:[/b] 20% damage reduction
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Alpha:[/b] 20% damage reduction
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Beta:[/b] 30% damage reduction
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Gamma:[/b] 40% damage reduction
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Delta:[/b] 60% damage reduction
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Omega:[/b] 60% damage reduction
 [/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ [b][i]Balancing:[/i][/b][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/a8c7d9a82ecf9d506221b8204c5c7195e854d57c.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also introduced balances based on player feedback to reduce run duration and enemy health, along with a few others adjustments.  [/p][list][*][p] Reduced base health of all enemies by about 10%
[/p][/*][*][p] Reduced grunt and grunt variants health scaling by 5%
[/p][/*][*][p] Reduced quantity of grunts and variants spawning during combat encounters from 6 to 3
[/p][/*][*][p] Increased duration between Strike Mantis' successive dash attacks in tower 3 encounters
[/p][/*][*][p] Reduced quantity of missiles fired from 4 to 3 when fighting Strike Mantis in tower 2 or 3 encounters
[/p][/*][*][p] Reduced missile speed by 20% when fighting Strike Mantis in tower 2 or 3 encounters
[/p][/*][*][p] Reduced travel speed of Wind Magistrate's tornadoes by about 15%
[/p][/*][*][p] Increased radius of the Volt Aura perk
[/p][/*][/list][h3]🖥️ [b][i]Changelogs:[/i][/b][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/f59e99757eb325bd3ccfd8eb30b9b7a08e3b2eac.png"][/img][/p][p]The Daily Challenge's points scoring will now only reward players for retaining up to the 200 HP maximum. Under this change, players with 400 HP and 200 HP at the end of their run are both rewarded the same 400 points.  [/p][list][*][p] Daily Challenge - Capped max health points to the base max
[/p][/*][*][p] Daily Challenge - Leaderboards now default to Global view
[/p][/*][/list][h3]🪲 [b][i]Community Requests & Bug Fixes:[/i][/b][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/9dea32cff9ab31d0f4df8aef560c71474faabd51.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p] Fixed persisting enemies & enemy effects when Overlord retaliation triggered during combat ending sequence
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Puzzle Switch chest in Robotics Factory that remained locked after completing the switch challenge
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed connectivity bug preventing players from launching and playing the game offline
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Robotics Hub trophy not appearing after all ciphers were discovered and decoded
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Golden Ada trophy not appearing after defeating VerOS with all Phantom Code Fragments enabled, despite some players receiving corresponding achievement
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Volt Colossus trophy that always loaded in gold by default
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed VFX bug in which the VFX for new trophies persisted after initial interaction
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed 'Quad Conquerer' achievement not being awarded when criteria was met
[/p][/*][/list][h3]🥊 [i][b]Next Shapers vs \[Metric] Showdown[/b][/i][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/c7559ab8ce43534bca2c9c0316919490f23da8ae.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🔗[url="https://discord.gg/KJfJe7bX?event=1372231052155813998"]Event Link[/url]
📅 Date: May 16
🎁 Battle Shapers Game Key + Goodies

[/p][/*][/list][p] A few players have asked for more predictable scoring when it comes to enemy takedowns. This new change means all score marked enemies (⭐) will go into exposed state when they die, making it both easier and faster to maximize combat scores. By eliminating a layer of luck or chance, this will better reward player awareness and decision-making.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/4abad67c63f811de180ac4fbfce2f0553b5fbbb5.png"][/img][/p][h3]🏆 [b][i]Achievements:[/i][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Carpe Diem: Earn a total of 3000 points in Daily Challenges. [/p][/*][*][p] Replay the daily challenge. Having a good synergy within your build is key to getting a high score. Replay the challenge and reroll your choices to see all your options and figure out your best course of action.
[/p][/*][*][p] Complete optional challenges. Optional challenges give you a lot of points and equipment that could be the deciding factor of a run.

notes.title: Update v1.1 - The Daily Challenge
notes.content:
[p]Hello Shapers! 👋

A new update for [i]Battle Shapers[/i] has arrived! Version 1.1 brings a brand new mode for Shapers: [b]the Daily Challenge[/b]! Designed to last about 10 minutes, this is a snack-sized feature where you race against fellow players to top the daily leaderboard in this time and point-based challenge. This feature is unlocked by defeating the first boss.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/cb0737ca4c3771a13fb0c6e851912904b55511d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every day, there will be a new configuration of weapons, abilities, enemies, cores, and more to tinker with as you battle your way through the challenge. You’ll earn bonus points for taking down enemies, defeating the Overlord, keeping your health bar full, and of course, time remaining on the clock.

This new mode is perfect for new and experienced Shapers alike. Whether you’re looking for the highest score or to discover dozens of loadout configurations available, the Daily Challenge has something for you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/1cb9a77742ac9ee6b1a48df61305d851bb360554.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/9dd2bb319755a66fa7a6817978014067cc7661a3.png"][/img][/p][p]Don’t forget to join the [url="https://discord.gg/AXU39BUsBJ"]Community Discord[/url] to compete with fellow players, talk strategy, debate which core is the best, and participate in future Daily Challenge contests & livestreams.

If you run into any bugs or have feedback on the update or the game, you can do so on our Discord as well!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/73fdf7c3ccb90b404e9199c4b28ff3b6e02f53f9.png"][/img]
A special shoutout to our Playtesters for v1.1! We had many champions vying to be the best, but these are our top three scorers from our community playtest:

🥇 1495 - @Zentafix
🥈 1428 - @InkAssassn
🥉 1341 - @Auseawesome

Now go out and see what scores you can set! If today’s challenge isn’t for you, tomorrow is always a whole new set of toys to tinker with. 

Thank you again for being a wonderful community and supporting [i]Battle Shapers[/i]. 💜

👋 [b]See you in New Elysium,[/b]

Colin & the team at Metric Empire[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.0.2.10092 Hotfix - Game Saves & Performance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/0247f4c27808fecdee2b44dbc47f02cff00045c6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hello Shapers,[/h3]

[b]Thank you for your support and reception of v1.0! [/b]

We've heard your feedback and have decided to make it [b]much more permissive for you to quit and resume your runs[/b] than how it was previously possible. As long as you don't die, you will now be able to quit the game at any point in the run and then resume it later from the start of the last floor you have reached, forfeiting any progress made on that specific floor instead of cancelling your run as a whole.

A minority of players reported having to restart their runs from the beginning due to crashes or softlock bugs, which we felt wasn't fair to them especially given how involving Battle Shapers runs are. This fix allows us to address the problem while we work on eliminating the bugs altogether. 

This hotfix patch also includes a fix for the performance degradation that happened for some players as well as a specific crash we identified.

Changelog for build 1.0.2.10092

[i][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Major save game rework; players can now leave a run at any point and without losing active run progress. If players quit during a floor or if the game crashes, they can resume the run from the most recent floor's starting point.
[*] Added new UI feedback for when players earn new Reroll Tokens.
[*] Added new UI feedback for when stacks of Curse are reduced.
[*] Added a Windowed display option.
[/list]
[i][b]Balancing Changes:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Phantom Code difficulty further increases enemy damage but reduces the amount of HP gained.
[*] Weapon Mod that boosts damage while consuming credits now costs 5 credits per shot.
[*] A stack of Curse is now removed when defeating a boss.
[*] Lowered the HP of Volt Colossus' Gigavolt Bomb attack.
[*] Moved the Invulnerable Enemies Phantom Code Effect from Gamma to Delta difficulty level.
[*] Reworked the Battering Ram's spread to be a bit wider.
[*] Reworked the Corrupted Shock Rifle's base damage scaling; the weapon's damage increase no longer stacks outside of combat and is now capped relative to the weapon's magazine size.
[/list]
[i][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed Phantom Code bug when using the Hideout Teleporter.
[*] Fixed the Combat Buff's icons sometimes not being visible.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Elite Voltrider attacks to not be used.
[*] Fixed a bug in which The Argument would disappear from your inventory when resuming a saved run.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Vatkins to not despawn at the end of a fight.
[*] Fixed minor localization issues.
[*] Fixed Performance Degradation when playing several time the Storm Scrapper in a session.
[/list]

We're keeping a close eye on feedback, so feel free to share any bug reports, thoughts, or questions in our Steam Discussions or in the [url=https://discord.gg/MJM5PcmpjX]Community Discord[/url]. 

Thank you, 
Metric Empire

It is with a lot of joy that we announce version 1.0 has officially arrived, just over a year after our early access release. [/h3]

We hope you enjoy diving fist-first into everything [b][i]Battle Shapers[/i][/b] has to offer. Version 1.0 marks our 10th major update in 14 months, and with every update, we've added countless weapons, abilities, build upgrades and mechanics, enemies and bosses, environments, narrative chapters, cinematics, gameplay balances, performance optimizations, and much more. 

[b]If you're new here[/b], welcome to [b][i]Battle Shapers[/i][/b]! We have a new trailer for you, as well as a demo for you to enjoy. You can read about our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1421290/announcements/detail/4491873334851535848]Demo features here[/url]. We also have a [url=https://discord.gg/MJM5PcmpjX]Community Discord[/url] where you can chat with fellow Shapers and reach our development team. The soundtrack's pretty tight, too. 

[i][b]Version 1.0 Launch Trailer: [/b][/i]

[previewyoutube=2DuU1Od3G0I;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][i]Demo Link: [/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450000/Battle_Shapers_Demo/

[b][i]Soundtrack Link: [/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2632470/Battle_Shapers_Soundtrack/

[b][i]Battle Shapers[/i][/b] is currently available on Steam and is [url=https://www.steamdeck.com/en/verified]Deck Verified[/url]! We're also on NIVIDIA's GeForceNOW platform. 


[h3][i]So what's in the 1.0 Phantom Code Update?[/i][/h3]

Quite a bit! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1421290/announcements/detail/4491873334851535848]We have a DevLog detailing all of 1.0 Phantom Code's features here.[/url]

[i][b]Version 1.0 Overview:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] By popular demand, we introduced a [b]new difficulty system[/b] called [i][b]The Phantom Code[/b][/i].
[*] Players already deep in the end-game will get to discover new narrative content to the game capturing [b][i]Battle Shapers[/i][/b]'s final chapter.
[*] Have excess Turinium? There's a new [b]Reroll Token Dispenser[/b], allowing players to [b]exchange Turinium for Reroll Tokens[/b] and redraw certain types of rewards. 
[*] If you have a favorite weapon or ability, then the new [b]Shaper Requisitions[/b] is for you. Like the Reroll Token Dispenser, this feature consumes Turinium and allows players to increase the odds of discovering certain weapons or abilities, as well as suppressing undesired ones.
[*] We added more [b]Corrupted Weapon Variants[/b] - there are now 24 in total! 
[*] New foes have been introduced to New Elysium; some enemies can now appear with [b]Cursed Corruption[/b], and VerOs will also retaliate by calling on his enforcer, '[b]The Cursed One[/b]'. 
[*] There's a new [b]Trophy Room[/b] to show off your wins. Over 20 trophies can now be unlocked through regular gameplay, and upgraded through various challenges.
[*] Speaking of wins, we've added 51 [b]Steam Achievements[/b] to capture key moments of your journey in New Elysium.
[*] We've made major strides in terms of [b]Performance Optimizations[/b] for 1.0. So far we've eliminate game stuttering, addressed resource-heavy explosive effects, and improved frame rates by 20-30% depending on user hardware. 
[/list]
[h3][i]What a wild ride.[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/3a705ff1e3374d15548507f742f7600f46d5dd07.png[/img]

[b][i]Battle Shapers[/i][/b], codenamed [b]Protorogue[/b] at the time, began as a passion project by a team of two. This was August 2018.

And then we were eight, and we were Metric Empire. Then we were more. Then the game started to take [i]shape[/i]. Then it was [b][i]Battle Shapers[/i][/b]. And now Metric Empire is about twenty members! 

We've learned good things come with time and we're glad we were patient. Launching in early-access allowed us to not only gradually introduce narrative content, but more importantly focus on player feedback to iterate and revisit gameplay mechanics and features. Being able to take a step back to see the bigger picture was a big advantage. 

Which brings us to our next topic.. 

[h3][i]Early-Access Shapers[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/a296fd5b29615dca7da2c6bdb07495f133813177.jpg[/img]
We [i][b]have to[/b][/i] extend a heartfelt thank you to every single one of our [b]early access Shapers[/b]!

The kindness, excitement, and support you have shown us in the last year has been incredibly moving. 

We are so tremendously grateful for every one of you. Every gesture, from simply playing the game, to reporting bugs, participating in playtests and surveys, engaging with our content, leaving a Steam review, sharing gameplay and narrative suggestions - every single one is appreciated. 

To make a game and have it received by our wonderfully supportive community is a privilege.

[h3][i]What's Next?[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/0af2ab80c15336d4a713f52ac95fe2cf0732666c.gif[/img]

We're going to take a moment to celebrate this massive milestone! 

Then, our team will regroup to set upcoming plans for Battle Shapers. Our biggest priorities right now will be to take the time to properly dive into our community's feedback & suggestions, continue improving the game, and provide regular hotfix patches for anything that might appear. 

We also have a few ideas for community-facing initiatives that we'll share in due time!

[h3][i]We need to wrap this up.[/i][/h3]

[b]We hope all past, present, and future Shapers enjoy this game as much as we did making it.

Thank you all so much.[/b]

[h3][i]Now, one last time:[/i][/h3]
[h2]We're [i][b]Metric Empire[/b][/i] and we [b]made[/b] [i][b]Battle Shapers[/b][/i]!🤘[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/e5326406718d72170082fda3f276f1032e336f18.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/c135ebc093260f79079c85eafb46870e0b514529.png[/img]

[i][h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3][/i]
[i][b]Weapons:[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/af1d3ce5d5a142bbc7eaaafe25e3aadb1233ce2c.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Added 9 new corrupted weapon variants to complete the full lineup of corrupted weapons.
[*]Corrupted Ion Blaster’s reload speed reduced from 2.1 to 1.8 seconds.
[*]Corrupted Crimson Repeater’s magazine size was reduced from 6 to 4.
[*]Quiver’s damage was reduced from 25 to 20 and explosion size was reduced.
[*]Corrupted Quiver’s main projectile damage was increased from 15 to 20.
[*]Scourge’s explosion damage was increased from 30 to 35.
[*]Corrupted Scourge’s explosion damage was reduced from 24 to 15.
[*]Plasma Carbine’s explosion radius increased and the number of stacks applied increased from 1 to 2.
[*]Shock Rifle’s damage was reduced from 8 to 7.
[*]Corrupted Wildfire explosion radius increased and main projectile damage reduced from 75 to 70.
[*]Corrupted Accelerator’s reload time reduced from 2.5 to 2.3 seconds.
[*]Tectonic Launcher’s damage increased from 15 to 17, explosion radius reduced and mag size reduced from 12 to 10.
[*]Corrupted Crescent Blade number of stacks applied reduced from 8 to 4.
[*]Infernal Stinger’s damage increased from 7 to 8.
[*]Megaton’s explosion damage increased from 35 to 45.
[*]Corrupted Megaton’s explosion damage increased from 55 to 60.
[*]Needleator’s damage increased from 5 to 6.
[*]Corrupted Needleator’s explosion damage was reduced from 13 to 8.5.
[*]Raging Blaze’s damage increased from 2 to 3.
[*]Corrupted Raging Blaze’s fire rate reduced from 15 to 11 and stack applied reduced from 2 to 1.
[*]Corrupted Aftershock’s magazine size increased from 12 to 15.
[*]Corrupted Havoc Hammer’s damage was reduced from 39 to 35.
[*]Splishot Kunai’s damage increased from 5 to 10 and rate of fire increased from 2 to 2.5.
[*]Corrupted Splitshot Kunais’ damage increased from 10 to 15.
[*]Corrupted Firehawk’s damage was reduced from 160 to 140 and charge time increased from 1.03 to 1.55 seconds.
[*]Enabled Plasma Carbine and Arc Flash compatibility with Chain effects and modifiers.
[*]General VFX improvement and polish for several weapons.
[/list]
[i][b]Abilities:[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/2ac19074115ee6a4caa845ec0fe2fb2752db6006.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Stun Grenade’s explosion damage increased from 20 to 40.
[*] Thermite Clusterbombs’ explosion radius increased.
[*] Pulse Grenade’s explosion damage increased from 40 to 46. It now applies 1 additional stack on direct hits.
[*] Bouncy Vibrobomb’s bounce damage bonus increased from 20% to 25% per bounce and bounce radius increased. 
[*] Sonic Boom’s explosion radius greatly increased and total stacks applied increased from 8 to 9.
[*] Clutch’s damage increased from 20 to 30.
[*] Plasma Blast’s radius greatly increased, impact explosion damage increased from 10 to 20 and stacks applied reduced from 4 to 2.
[*] Leap Slam’s knockback force increased.
[*] Shock Breaker’s damage increased from 20 to 30.
[*] Echo Wave’s duration increased from 2 to 6 seconds.
[*] MirrorShot Turret’s cooldown increased from 20 to 22 seconds and damage reduced from 16 to 10.
[*] Sunflare Turret’s cooldown increased from 20 to 22 seconds. Stacks applied reduced from 2 to 1 and damage increased from 12 to 13.
[*] Gyrovolt Turret’s cooldown increased from 20 to 22 seconds. Stacks applied reduced from 2 to 1 and damage reduced from 12 to 10.
[*] Scatterblast Turret’s cooldown increased from 20 to 22 seconds. Stacks applied reduced from 3 to 2 and damage reduced from 15 to 12.
[*] Thundersnap’s damage increased from 5 to 10.
[*] Nanite Swarm’s damage increased from 5 to 10 per second, reduced duration from 10 to 6 seconds.
[*] Sync Wave’s damage increased from 12 to 25.
[/list]
[i][b]Talents:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Added new Auto-Collector talent, allowing automatic collection of rewards after combat.
[*] Increased Combat Armor and Combat Shields talents max rank from 8 to 10.
[*] Added new Shaper Requisitions talent, unlocked with the Phantom Compiler.
[*] Added new Reroll Token Dispenser talent, unlocked with the Phantom Compiler.
[*] Huck’s Emporium is now rerolled by spending Reroll Tokens instead of credits.
[/list]
[i][b]Modifiers, Buffs and Hacks:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Shock now triggers EMP both on max stack and on victim’s death. Its effect scales with the number of stacks at which it was triggered.
[*] Vibro’s damage sharing effect will now only apply once per group of foes caught in a same explosion.
[*] Reduced Rapidfire’s rate of fire bonus from 10% to 5% per stack.
[*] Enabled compatibility of some common energy-type based modifiers with gear of the same energy type.
[*] Override: Ability and Override: Weapon hacks now add the override reward in addition to the base reward found in the room.
[*] Reduced base damage of all 4 Bomb Hacks by around 10%.
[*] Added 4 new Greater Hacks that have persistent effects accruing over the course of the run.
[/list]
[i][b]Core Enhancements:[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/6dfd6ad37669996463d2f600418c9e6d884bae01.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Emergency Reboot now has a cooldown.
[*] Hardware Extractor now has a max total health gain of 100 health.
[*] Focused Fire now has a cooldown.
[*] Critical Blasts now has a cooldown.
[*] Reflective Recycling’s cooldown reduction effect lowered from 10% to 5%.
[*] Ruthless Onslaught’s proc chance reduced from 100% to 50%
[*] Reckless Rush now refreshes your Dash without having to pass through foes.
[*] Energized Finale’s explosion radius increased from 8 to 10m.
[*] Reflective Finale’s radius has been greatly increased.
[*] Vengeful Wind’s reflective effect duration has been increased.
[*] Overkill ability cooldown increased from 8 to 14 seconds.
[*] Overkill Refactor’s cooldown increased from 8 to 14 seconds.
[*] Heavy Assault cooldown increased from 16 to 28 seconds.
[*] Falcon Dive’s cooldown increased from 8 to 14 seconds.
[*] Panic Protocol’s chance to gain shields increased from 20 to 25%.
[*] Burst Retaliators’ cooldown increased from 3.5 to 5 seconds.
[*] Cyclonic Dive will now shoot identical copies of your main, upgraded Air Blade.
[*] Battle Hardened’s number Fortify stacks on takedown reduced from 2 to 1.
[/list]
[i][b]Story:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Added the final act of the story that follows the introduction of the Phantom Code.
[*] Added dozens of new optional Overlords conversations.
[*] Added extra story conversations and banters with Meemo in the hideout.
[*] Added new Apparitions conversations in all biomes following the corruption of the Overlords.
[/list]
[i][b]Enemies:[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/a67de2ebe7e9943721a4df93d55e1bb24de43dc1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/33b158326da503ff5fa4a89710f724b93bf7162f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a new type of corruption crystals: Cursed Corruption.
[*] Added a new enemy: the Cursed One.
[*] Reduced the Centurion’s base health by around 10%.
[*] Increased the Arbiter’s shield regeneration delay from 0.75 to 2 seconds.
[*] Adjusted the health and damage of Captains and Elites.
[*] General enemy health and damage balancing pass.
[/list]
[i][b]Bosses:[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/9e64ba522dbd5726bfb01cd11be6ad7a1447445c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/e12d074030d584a66a2df67e095a1452ace69a00.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Reduced the total health of Volt Colossus’ gigavolt bomb attack.
[*] Added well-needed health bars for VerOS’s tentacles.
[*] Balanced VerOS’s health and several of its special attacks and abilities.
[*] VerOS can now use its own unique retaliation.
[/list]
[i][b]User Interface:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Added visual inputs and controls in several tutorials.
[*] Added new Phantom Code menu, accessible through the Phantom Compiler in the hideout.
[*] Improved gameplay description UX with colored stats, styling and new tooltips.
[*] UI Improvements for Success Screen, Death Screen, Battle Logs and Inventory Menus.
[*] UI Improvements for the Cipher Shop and support for Shaper Requisitions feature.
[*] Added menu option to turn off the HUD Sway effect.
[*] Added separate menu options to control Crosshair Opacity and Color
[/list]
[i][b]Others:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Added 21 collectible trophies to earn and display in the Hideout’s trophy room.
[*] Added 50 new Steam achievements.
[/list]
[i][b]Biomes:[/b][/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/31bbbce2c196b079ebbfeb9d3b8740c4f7099c17.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/abdb7925455d3dc7faf14a4e97eb31d05f90ffed.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Added new Phantom Compiler and Reroll Token Dispenser devices in the Hideout.
[*] Added a new Trophy Room section to the Hideout.
[*] Added brand new combat rooms in the Hideout, Robotics Hub, Stormscraper and Gravity Garden.
[*] Added Corrupted Lootboxes, a new optional challenge in all Biomes
[*] Relocated the High Capacity Weapons and High Capacity Abilities ciphers in the Orbital Complex.
[/list]
[i][h3]Bug Fixes [/h3][/i]
[b](*) Indicates community reported issues. Big thanks to everyone in our community for reporting bugs during the Early Access and open beta phases.[/b]
[list]
[*] 
[*] Fixed a rendering issue on the Orbital Complex in the Stage Select screen (*)
[*] Fixed text issues on several Gear Modifiers (*)
[*] Fixed text issues in some Cipher Cloud descriptions (*)
[*] Fixed a collision issue allowing player to leave the Hideout room (*)
[*] Fixed Vibro damage inconsistencies against VerOS (*)
[*] Fixed text issue in High Capacity Weapons and Abilities’ Talents description
[*] Fixed issue with the Air Blade projectiles being vertical (*)
[*] Fixed issue with Crimson Repeater sound effects staying active (*)
[*] Fixed numerous UI overlap issues
[*] Fixed widescreen resolution scaling issues
[*] Fixed multiple problem when navigating menus with the controller 
[*] Fixed issues in the Display Options menu
[*] Fixed some Cipher Cloud videos not correctly playing on Steam Deck
[*] Fixed issues with health bars not always rendering correctly
[*] Fixed Shaper Rift Traversals miscounting player fails
[*] Fixed the “Gain 1 Shield per hit with your ability” modifier when used with turret abilities
[*] Fixed the Vibro damage being scaled twice
[*] Fixed the origin point of bullets being misplaced after using Reflective Punches
[*] Fixed weapon projectiles that both Bounce and Pierce to not always apply damage
[*] Fixed AI navigation issues in Gravity Garden’s lockdown challenge room
[*] Fixed Corrupted Nest not always spawning a reward
[*] Fixed Bombs appearing to float over the floor in some rooms
[*] Fixed collision issues in the different Huck’s Emporium rooms
[*] Fixed issues with Corrupted Nest rewards clipping in walls
[*] Fixed issue wherein extra icons would appear on the minimap (*)
[*] Fixed typo in Fortifying Absorption enhancement name
[*] Fixed stability problems with the Shock Amplification hack
[*] Fixed an issue with the removal of Elite enemies’ floor decals
[*] Fixed the Leap Slam animation not playing when the player is using Windstep
[*] And much more!
[/list]
[i][b]Known Issue(s):[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] There is a problem when changing the screen resolution when your window mode is set to Fullscreen. An easy workaround is to change your resolution and revert it back to your preferred settings. This issue will be fixed in a hotfix version soon.
[/list]
[b]We hope all past, present, and future Shapers enjoy this game as much as we did making it.

Thank you all so much. 
Metric Empire 🤘[/b]

notes.title: DevLog: Upcoming Features in v1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Shapers,[/h2]

With version 1.0 dropping next week on December 4th, what better time is there to share update details? 

Read on to preview upcoming features and discover more about the Phantom Code. 

[i][b]Version 1.0 Overview:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] New Difficulty System - The Phantom Code
[*] New Narrative Content
[*] New Reroll Token Dispenser
[*] New Shaper Requisitions
[*] New Corrupted Weapon Variants
[*] New Corrupted Enemies & the “Cursed One”
[*] New Trophy Room
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Performance Optimizations
[*] 0.9.2 Hotfix!
[/list]
[h3][i][b]The Phantom Code: Optional Difficulty System[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/e5326406718d72170082fda3f276f1032e336f18.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/c135ebc093260f79079c85eafb46870e0b514529.png[/img]
By popular community demand, a whole new difficulty system is being added in the endgame allowing skilled players to select additional challenges and set the overall difficulty tier at the beginning of their runs. Successful runs at increased difficulty tiers unlock gameplay rewards and are necessary to reach the game’s true ending.
[list]
[*] The Phantom Compiler is a new hideout device built by Meemo to crack the secrets of the Phantom Code Fragment you earn after beating VerOs for the first time.
[*] You must obtain four Code Fragments to access the game’s true ending, each one obtainable by defeating VerOS at progressively higher difficulty levels - from Alpha, Beta, Gamma to Delta difficulty.
[*] Earning these Code Fragments gives you new rewards, but most importantly, unlocks many Fragment Effects, difficulty modifiers that alter the game’s challenges in new unexpected ways and make it possible to earn the next Fragment.
[*] There are 20 Fragment Effects to unlock in total, each one offering a unique influence on the game’s difficulty.
[*] Once the four Code Fragments are in your possession, the true test - Omega Difficulty - becomes accessible, paving the way for the game’s true ending.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/854fcdb80a0c067d95a8e757196d678135a47a31.gif[/img]

[h3][i][b]Narrative Content:[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/c7de9fa0514ed2fd7cca76d95be66614d416d8a9.jpg[/img]
Following the introduction of VerOS (the final boss) and the Orbital Complex (the final tower), and the Corruption Update, the Phantom Code Update brings the final game ending to Battle Shaper’s story after a long-awaited year in early-access.

[b]Apparitions[/b] are special interactions that allow players to converse with the Overlords (bosses) and discover new sides of their personalities, which is only revealed after a dramatic event that happens in the later phases of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/6949a64014a6fff948ece2e019a91bd19355a06e.gif[/img]

[h3][i][b]Reroll Token Dispenser & Shaper Requisitions (Turinium Sink):[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/31bbbce2c196b079ebbfeb9d3b8740c4f7099c17.gif[/img]

Endgame players with excess wealth will now be able to spend their Turinium using the Shaper Requisitions and Reroll Token Dispenser, special unlockable features earned in the later phases of the game.

Reroll Tokens, introduced in past updates, are a valuable currency that allows players to re-draw rewards from the pool of power-ups and abilities (Shaper Core Enhancements), as well as environmental features and rewards (Floor Hacks). Using the Reroll Token Dispenser will allow players to purchase extra tokens in advance for their runs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/9458ab10a27281607a00e721781023abbf0c93ba.gif[/img]

Using Shaper Requisitions, a nifty upgrade to the Cipher Cloud, players will be able to Requisition their favorite weapons or abilities to give them a much higher chance to appear in their run, or Suppress those they wish to not encounter altogether.

[h3][i][b]Corrupted Weapons:[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/af1d3ce5d5a142bbc7eaaafe25e3aadb1233ce2c.gif[/img]

There are now a total of 24 Corrupted Weapons to craft your builds with! 

After defeating VerOs for the first time, all weapons have a chance to spawn with the “Corrupted” affix which greatly alters weapon properties and stats. At the time of this update, there are 15 unique corrupted weapons for you to discover, including a Corrupted Tectonic Launcher variant that shoots tornadoes, and a Corrupted Needleator variant that shoots bouncing grenades.

[h3][i][b]VerOS Retaliation:[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/e12d074030d584a66a2df67e095a1452ace69a00.png[/img]
[b]Beware![/b] VerOS will now occasionally retaliate, similar to the other Overlords.

[h3][i][b]New Corrupted Enemies and the “Cursed One”:[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/33b158326da503ff5fa4a89710f724b93bf7162f.jpg[/img]
Unleashed after defeating VerOS for the first time, enemies may now appear protected by a new type of Corruption: Cursed Corruption which not only makes them tougher, but enables them to inflict VerOS’ Curse with their attacks. As if it’s not enough, VerOS will now also retaliate by calling upon its ruthless enforcer - the Cursed One - to surprise you in battle. Good luck, Shaper.

[h3][i][b]Hideout Trophies:[/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/abdb7925455d3dc7faf14a4e97eb31d05f90ffed.jpg[/img]
Jazz up your base with shiny golden trophies! A trophy room has been added to visually showcase players’ progress as they liberate towers, defeat enemies, and complete the narrative content over the course of their runs. Unlock trophies in the hideout through regular gameplay and upgrade them by completing different challenges.

[h3][i][b]Steam Achievements:[/b][/i][/h3]

There are now over 51 new achievements added for the most devoted completionists, capturing moments such as when players execute vengeful Overlord takedowns, destroy bots with maximum efficiency, and many more! 

[h3][i][b]Performance Optimizations:[/b][/i][/h3]
Game performance has been improved significantly since early access launch in October 2023 and recent optimizations considerably improve framerates in high-octane encounters. Other improvements include gameplay balances, UI fixes, and bug fixes that will be detailed in our 1.0 patch notes.
[list]
[*] Fixed all game stuttering issues.
[*] Fixed issues with explosion-heavy build effects being performance-heavy.
[*] Improved overall framerates by 20% to 30% depending on hardware.
[/list]
[h3][i][b]0.9.2 Hotfix coming soon:[/b][/i][/h3]
To keep improving the game while waiting for the 1.0 release, we prepared a 0.9.2 update for current players that captures a portion of optimizations and bug fixes from the upcoming 1.0 build. We will be pushing this live on Monday December 2nd.


[h3]That's all for now! We can't overstate how excited we are to get this game into your hands.[/h3]

See you at our version 1.0 release next week! 

À bientôt, 
Metric Empire 🤘

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/2dadf22f24198a794d0208756c61c1f3e81a6100.png[/img]
[b][h3]We're so proud of how much our community, our team, and our game has grown. Join us in celebrating this journey we've been on together![/h3][/b]

[b]🎃 Autumn 2023 (0.2, 0.3, 0.4)[/b]

Following game launch, we worked quickly to add a world of planned content including a new tower, new gameplay mechanics, and a host of planned additions such as enemies, weapons, and abilities.
[list]
[*] Features: Power Transfer (now Mod Extractor) allows you to swap modifiers between gear, Core Affinity, Core Enhancers, Cache Keys

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/1a4379f576855d16775f41cb6efc523818e149a2.png[/img]

[b]☃️ Winter 2024 (0.5)[/b]

After our first 3 months in Early Access, we kicked off the new year with a deep dive into your initial feedback and saw we had work to do. We rolled up our sleeves and devoted two updates focused on improving weapon interactions, the user interface, and the overall gameplay experience.
[list]
[*] Key Changes: Hideout Rooms, Battle Logs, Weapon Gameplay, Enemy Projectiles, Enemy Count, HUD Feedback, Quality of Life Improvements, Analytics & Balancing
[*] Activities: 0.5 Playtest

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/9e64ba522dbd5726bfb01cd11be6ad7a1447445c.jpg[/img]
[b]🌱 Spring 2024 (0.6, 0.7)[/b]

Things really started shaping up in Spring. We were met with a wave of encouragement from our partners and the community (you!) as we continued fine-tuning the gameplay experience and began introducing our late-game content.
[list]
[*] Features: Greater Hacks that persist the entire run, supercharging builds
[*] Towers: The Orbital Complex
[*] Enemies: VerOS
[*] Game: Good?
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/8396b96bff49a989f264a5909396995bfde408ab.png[/img]
[b]🏖️ Summer 2024 (0.8, 0.9)[/b]

That tingle of excitement is back. We were granted a Daily Deal feature on Steam right as we were reimagining the Mod Extractor. With so many changes, we rolled out two playtests to ensure the game was in a great state. We’ve also partnered with a fellow Shaper to make a 1:1 scale model of the Ion Blaster to say thank you for supporting us.
[list]
[*] Features: Mod Extractor based on community feedback, +40 Core Enhancers (Major & Minor), End-game Corruption Content, Player Curse

Is this the end? There’s still so much to do! The next few weeks are a mad dash, but with how things are going, we’re feeling confident. Our full 1.0 release will include our final narrative content alongside a number of late-game features you have been asking for. We will have a couple announcements coming soon.
[list]
[*] Features: Replayability Difficulty, Achievements, Trophies, and more
[*] Weapons: More Corrupted Weapon Variants
[*] Activities: 1.0 Playtest
[*] Goodies: More!

[h3]🙏 Thank you not only for your enthusiasm for Battle Shapers, but also for your patience and support for Metric Empire. 

We’re honored to have you with us, Shapers.[/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.9.0
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hey Shapers![/h3][/b]
The Corruption Update is here! We've added more features to improve build variability and the next phase of Overlord narrative. We've also taken a look at mod compatibility and gear leveling systems in response to community feedback and made a bunch of changes that we hope y'all love!

[i][b]New Feature: Corrupted Overlords[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/ed217125d85cd6d24fc81e852a36131da7b1d066.png[/img]
Without spoiling too much, we have added a point after which Overlords will become corrupted. This adds a twist on to the Overlord encounters, changing their visuals, dialogue, and makes some of their attacks more dangerous. 

[i][b]New Feature: Gear Affixes[/b][/i]

Gear will now drop with 1 of 17 unchangeable affixes. These affixes will affect gear stats, ranging from modifying damage, to weapons' rate of fire, and even projectiles' size and speed. We wanted to add even more variety to the weapons in your runs and allow you to discover new weapon/affix combinations to improve your builds in interesting and interactive ways. 

[i][b]New Feature: Corrupted Weapons[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/5675c1c772bd2cf5244b361e9fa5774f1095e66c.gif[/img]

One of the potential affixes that can appear is the [i]Corrupted[/i] affix, unlocked after you have defeated VerOS at least once. This affix significantly alters weapon properties, turning it into something entirely different. In this update we've added the corrupted versions of 15 weapons - try to find them all! In our next major update, the remaining weapons will have their corrupted variants added.

[i][b]Reworked: Gear Leveling[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/7b223cfa046bb02cf6b8fffae3210bb6cbf9dd4e.png[/img]

We've reworked the way gear level affects the scaling of your weapons and abilities. There are now 6 gear levels in total, and once you have access to the Cipher Cloud, you will be able to upgrade the gear level of your weapons and abilities by spending gold at Huck’s Emporium.

[i][b]New Content: Curse Debuff[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/6f05307e07fc8c1b4cad3aceb04faa1153c95c80.png[/img]

To increase the difficulty of end-game runs, we’ve added the [i]Curse[/i] debuff. This debuff will lower Ada’s max health per stack. You will cleanse one stack of Curse with each encounter you clear. Once you defeat VerOS for the first time, the eyes in the Orbital complex will begin to apply the Curse debuff to players. Corrupted Overlords will also apply Curse to players with some of their attacks. In the next major update, we will add a more ways for players to receive Curse stacks.

[i][b]Major Improvement: Gear Modifier Compatibility[/b][/i]

We’ve previously had many gear modifier and gear combinations set to be incompatible due to technical constraints, but we’ve gone through the full list and removed a majority of these incompatible combinations. You should now have the freedom to play with more combinations of gear and modifiers than ever before!

[h3][b]Changelog V0.9.0[/b][/h3]

[i][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Improved the clarity of the Mod Extractor UI with new animations
[*]Adjusted animation timing of Falcon Dive to improve gameplay feel

[*]Added an indicator for optional side paths in rooms with two new pathways

[*]Reworked the barrier boss trait icon to look more like the in-game visual
[*]Added UI for extra Hunter’s marks when the player has the required Core Enhancers
[/list]
[i][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/i]

[*]Fixed an issue allowing barrels to explode each other causing chain reactions that would drastically drop FPS
[*]Fixed an issue causing pierce triggers to behave erratically when used on the Accelerator
[*]Fixed an issue causing the weapon switch animation to not play when switching weapon between slots in the inventory

notes.content:
[h3][b]S̴͓͌h̸̰̀a̵̙͊ṕ̷̤e̶̬̓r̶̡̆s̵̤̔!̶̠͘ ̷̝͂V̵̰̇e̷̛̤r̸̖̄Ȏ̸̗s̵̡̈́'̶̗͝ ̶̯͐c̴͕͊o̸͇͂r̴̪̾r̵̲̎u̴̮̒p̷̱͌t̷̫͒i̸̭͋o̴̭͗ṋ̸̽ ̷̨́s̸̲͘p̵̪̎ŗ̶͌ḙ̷̋a̷̤͌ḓ̴͐š̵͙ ̷̭͌a̴̖̾c̴͕͊r̴̰͂o̴̘͐š̴͇s̷̥͗ ̴̡͗N̸̹͘e̴̞̕w̸̙̓ ̸̹͋E̸̺͗ḻ̵͠y̶̟̚s̷̾͜ị̷̀u̴̞͐m̷͖̕!̸̹̈́ ̸̊ͅ
(Shapers! VerOs' corruption spreads across New Elysium!)[/b][/h3]

VerOs has become enraged by the Overlords’ continued failures and has taken matters into his own hands (read: tentacles). Strike Mantis, Volt Colossus, and Wind Magistrate fall victim to VerOs’ corruption as he unfolds his plans for New Elysium. 

The 0.9 Corruption Update brings a combination of content and gameplay features, including brand new Overlord encounters, new weapon variants, new gear modifiers, gear leveling, and more. 

[b]tl;dr:[/b]
[list]
[*] New corrupted overlord encounters
[*] New corrupted weapons
[*] New gear modifiers
[*] New player curse debuff mechanic
[*] Gear leveling returns through Huck's Emporium
[/list]
[h3]What's New?[/h3]

[i][b]New Content: Corrupted Overlords[/b][/i]

When you defeat VerOs, you begin the journey to unlocking Corrupted Overlords in your subsequent runs. This adds a twist on Overlord encounters with narrative and gameplay features for players to discover. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/ed217125d85cd6d24fc81e852a36131da7b1d066.png[/img]

[i][b]New Feature: Weapon Affixes[/b][/i]

Gear now rolls with a random unchangeable affix that affects its stats. These affixes modify a variety of weapon stats from damage, to the rate of fire, and even to the sizes of projectiles. 

[i][b]New Feature: Corrupted Weapon Variants[/b][/i]

After defeating VerOs for the first time, all weapons have a chance to spawn with the “Corrupted” affix which greatly alters weapon properties and stats. At the time of this update, there are 15 unique corrupted weapons for you to discover, including a vibro rocket launcher variant that shoots tornadoes, and a submachine gun variant that shoots bouncing grenades. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/5675c1c772bd2cf5244b361e9fa5774f1095e66c.gif[/img]

[i][b]New Feature: Curse Debuff[/b][/i]

This is a stacking debuff applied to players that will reduce their total maximum health. Once cursed, you can purge one stack of the curse for each encounter you clear. After defeating VerOS the first time, the Evil Oculi in the Orbital Complex will apply this debuff. This debuff can also be received from specific attacks by Corrupted Overlords.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/6f05307e07fc8c1b4cad3aceb04faa1153c95c80.png[/img]

[i][b]New Feature: Gear Leveling[/b][/i]

We have reworked the way gear level affects the scaling of your weapons and abilities. There are now 6 gear levels in total, and once you have access to the Cipher Cloud, you will be able to upgrade the gear level of your weapons and abilities by spending gold at Huck’s Emporium.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/7b223cfa046bb02cf6b8fffae3210bb6cbf9dd4e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/fc86922ecf2c9a87fe5c763907bfc909c4b5e758.png[/img]

[i][b]Mod Compatibility[/b][/i]

We spent a notable amount of time revisiting modifier compatibility. Following the introduction of the Mod Extractor feature (previously Power Transfer), we received a lot of community feedback surrounding the clarity of modifier compatibility. In this update, the majority of previously incompatible mods and weapon combinations can now be combined. This will bring more fun through deeper build diversity and [i]just a little[/i] less confusion overall. 

[h3]Changelog[/h3]

A full changelog will be released on September 18th, following a few final bug fixes and optimizations.

[h3]Endgame Content[/h3]

[i][b]Phantom Code[/b][/i]

A lot of you have been asking about endgame content - you have been heard. We have something planned to specifically address endgame difficulty and replayability, a feature we have codenamed [i][b]Phantom Code[/b][/i]. 

We will share these plans and so much more in a development update when the time is right.

[h3]Beta Playtest & Feedback[/h3]

Your dedication, feedback, and suggestions are at the core of what we do! It is always exciting for us to hear what our players want to see next in Battle Shapers. 

Our community playtests have also been incredibly helpful to quickly assess what works and what needs fine-tuning ahead of the upcoming update, so thank you so much for all those who make time to support our development process. 

Please do not hesitate to continue sharing your thoughts & feelings with us across our Steam reviews and Steam discussions! You can also always reach our developers directly through [url=https://discord.gg/MJM5PcmpjX]our community Discord[/url].

[h3]Thank You! [/h3]

Thank you all so much for all of your support! 

Thank you for everyone's playtest support, every one of your recommendations & bug reports, and inspiring content ideas.  

This is truly a special community and we appreciate you.

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.8.0: The Synergy Update
notes.content:
Hey Shapers!

The Synergy Update is here! We’ve done a myriad of redesigns and added a bunch of new content all in service of replayability and build diversity.

[b]New Feature: Major and Minor Core Enhancers[/b]

We’ve reworked the way Core Enhancers are found in runs and split them into two categories, major and minor enhancers. Now, at milestone moments throughout your runs, you will be granted a choice between 3 major core enhancers that alter your gameplay in drastic ways, such as overriding your core ability or even your punch.

[b]New Content: 38 New Core Enhancers[/b]

To support this new system, we’ve added a whopping 38 new core enhancers, 18 major enhancers and 20 new minor enhancers. This is going to add optionality to your runs and make each run you play feel unique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/33e3fea1cd9c4dcbaf1e32e8516d77036d09adc8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/6dfd6ad37669996463d2f600418c9e6d884bae01.gif[/img]

[b]New Feature: Mod Extractor[/b]

We have completely overhauled our Power Transfer feature and renamed it the Mod Extractor. Instead of moving gear modifiers from weapon to weapon, you can now extract the modifier and add them to your build permanently. This will allow you to build up permanent power throughout the course of a run and create a long-term plan to maximize synergy between your extracted mods, your weapons and your core enhancers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/6e932ea2280228f5a4172b4a9e167f64bffef3af.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/88424a0e009ce701173c243d9a7c80cee0b08513.png[/img]

[b]Upgraded: Wind Core and Volt Core[/b]

We’ve reworked various aspects of the Wind Core and the Volt Core to bring them more in line with the quality and power level of Ada Core and Strike Core. These changes also set us up to create awesome new core enhancers for both.

[b]Wind Core Shotgun Blade:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/284f714e32a617ac2e3f74a9c5611ef170c0119c.gif[/img]


[b]Wind Core Tornado Blade:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/be9cd4a081676a63144a7b35c5ed856838c4c57f.gif[/img]

[b]Volt Core's Echoing Thunder:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/8a342b3bea2dab40f64912e448710f356572b348.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/2ac19074115ee6a4caa845ec0fe2fb2752db6006.gif[/img]

[b]Changelog V0.8.0[/b]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Major Core Enhancers: Now at the last room of each floor, players will be given a choice of Major core enhancers. All other core enhancers obtained during a run will grant a choice of minor enhancers.
[*]18 new major core enhancers added to the game. NOTE: Some of these enhancers currently lack an icon, this will be fixed in a future update.
[*]20 new minor core enhancers added to the game. NOTE: Some of these enhancers currently lack an icon, this will be fixed in a future update.
[*]Power Transfer reworked into the Mod Extractor. Mods extracted from gear are now placed into mod slots inside Ada’s inventory. These mod slots will apply mod effects to all future gear placed in the corresponding gear slots. This will allow you to keep and utilize powerful mods you find for the entire run.
[*]Mod Extraction selection now goes through the inventory screen
[*]Removed the ability to change the level of gear through transferring mods
[*]Windstep now launches you high in the air instead of letting you stay afloat and glide
[*]Dashing with the Wind Core equipped is now omnidirectional
[*]Volt Orbs now start off larger and shrink each time they hit an enemy
[*]Volt Orbs no longer move towards enemies by default
[*]Ada Core Outburst no longer deals damage on contact by default
[*]Rebalanced weapon and ability gear level scaling to account for new permanent gear modifiers
[*]Rebalanced enemy health to account for new player power level expectations
[*]Added new talents to expand mod slot capacity
[*]Adjusted the scaling of health and shield talents
[*]Added feedback for maxed out affinity after defeating an Overlord
[*]Added SFX to indicate when you are hitting corrupted enemies with the wrong damage type
[*]Added a new visual for major core enhancers
[*]Optimizations done to increase frame rate during combat
[*]Added screenshake when an Overlord dies
[/list]
[b]New Core Enhancers[/b]
[list]
[*]Power Rush - After a dash, your next instance of damage is empowered by 50%.
[*]Quick Recompile - Dashing refills all your magazines.
[*]Cyclonic Vortex - Your takedown explosions pull nearby enemies.
[*]Critical Moment - Every 10 shots, gain an enhanced shot with high critical chance and improved critical damage.
[*]Raging Reflects - Projectiles reflected by your punch grant Fury.
[*]Vicious Dash - Dashstrike increases target’s debuff stacks by 25%
[*]Hardware Refresh - Heal for 5% of your Max HP upon completing a room.
[*]Polarizing Punch - Enemies you punch instantly become Magnetized.
[*]Stunning Detonator - Takedown explosions have a chance to stun enemies on hit.
[*]Scattershot Blade - You now shoot multiple short ranged Air Blades in a scattered pattern.
[*]Power in Decay - For every 1% missing HP, gain 1% increased damage.
[*]Emergency Countermeasures - When your shields are down and you take a hit, refund Outburst cooldown.
[*]Return on Investment - Takedowns grant you 10 credits.
[*]Break 2.0 - Increases Breaks critical hit chance by 20% and critical hit damage by 50%.
[*]Optimal Conditions - When in the air, all your attacks deal 20% more damage. On the ground, you deal 10% less.
[*]High Ground - Airblades deal 20% more damage when you’re in the air.
[*]Flight Plan - Dashing resets your Windstep.
[*]Rushing Talon - Vaulting over enemies resets your dash cooldown.
[*]Combat Impetus - Killing an enemy resets your dash cooldown.
[*]Circuit Buster - Precision hits deal an extra 50% damage.
[*]Cluster Might - Deal 20% extra damage for every enemy within 10m, up to 100%.
[*]Panic Protocol - When your shields are down and you take a hit, there's a 20% chance you will regain shields.
[*]Breaker’s Dash - Dashstrike inflicts Break.
[*]Defensive Nova - For 5 seconds after Volt Slam, take 50% less damage.
[*]Haste Overclock - Get cooldown reduction on your dash for each stack of haste.
[*]Hurricane Blade - Airblades travel slower and shoot slower but explode on impact.
[*]Emergency Reboot - Reloads all your weapons and recharges main Ability on shield break
[*]Calibrated Blast - Increases takedown explosion damage by 50%.
[*]Hardware Upgrade - Increase max HP by 40.
[*]Flight Dynamics - Increase move speed in the air by 15%.
[*]Chaining Reflects - Projectiles reflected by your punch also chain to nearby enemies.
[*]Rapidfire Overkill - Recharge Overkill faster for each stack of Rapidfire.
[*]Violent Restitution - Critical hits refund 1 bullet to your magazine.
[*]Pressure Advantage - When your core gauge becomes full, gain 5 stacks of Haste and Deadeye.
[*]Gravitational Break - Killing an enemy affected by Break creates an explosion that pulls in nearby enemies.
[*]Critical Countermeasures - After your shield breaks, all shots are critical for 3 seconds.
[*]Space Time Matrix - Dashing refunds 1 second of all your other cooldowns.
[*]Shield System Patch - You gain 20 max shield.
[/list]

[*]Fixed an issue causing fences to disappear without breaking when shot

[*]Fixed a bug allowing players to move their camera freely during takedowns
[*]Fixed various grammatical issues and typos throughout the game
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.7.0: The Transcendence Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8ydp8S0fdHo;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey Shapers!

The Transcendence Update is here! Full runs are now in the game with the introduction of The Orbital Complex and our final boss, VerOS. Explore the last biome in the game, experience a new challenge and take on the final boss for the first time ever!

[b]New Biome: The Orbital Complex[/b]

The final biome is here, a dangerous and shadowy tower, the command center of VerOS, the mysterious Overlord responsible for the corruption and hijacking of New Elysium. Fight in the most challenging encounters yet, including fights that contain more enemy variants and a new type of trap. 

[b]Final Boss: VerOS[/b]

Once you reach the final room of the Orbital Complex, take on VerOS, our latest and greatest boss fight. Defeat him and get one step closer to liberating your city from the spreading corruption! Unlock new narrative content as you progress through the last leg of your runs.

[b]New Feature: Greater Hacks[/b]

We've added another way to add power to your builds through the Greater Hacks system. Each time you liberate a tower, you'll now gain access to a Greater Hack selection. This will allow you to select one of three hacks that applies for the rest of your run. There are 19 new hacks available through this system for you to find new ways to supercharge your builds.

[b]New Feature: Hideout Teleporter[/b]

Once you unlock the starter weapon and starter ability ciphers, you'll now gain access to the Hideout teleporter. This teleporter will move you directly in front of the exit towards Stage Select from the Hideout.

[b]Changelog V0.7.0[/b]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]The Orbital Complex is now available after liberating all three towers
[*]The VerOS boss fight is now available at the end of the Orbital Complex
[*]Added the Evil Oculi, a new environmental hazard for the Orbital Complex
[*]Three new bangin' soundtracks for the new biome and bossfight
[*]Global Hacks: Select city-wide hacks each time you defeat an Overlord and liberate a tower in your runs
[*]Adjusted scaling health of enemy captain and elites to make them less tanky
[*]Added a teleporter visual to make teleporters more obvious when leaving a room off of the main path
[*]Added a teleporter to skip from The Hideout directly to Stage Select when the player has unlocked the necessary ciphers
[*]Added new cutscenes for defeating the final boss
[*]Increased the homing of taken down enemies towards nearby foes. This will allow you to more consistently utilize takedown explosions to damage other enemies.
[*]Improved the visuals of the electric floor trap in the Stormscraper to make them more easily identifiable
[*]Strike Mantis' drone will now spawn nearer to Ada during boss retaliations
[*]Unlocked final levels of several ciphers to prepare players for the final leg of their run
[*]Added feedback for maxed out affinity after defeating an Overlord
[*]Added VFX and SFX for recycling
[*]Optimizations for lower end machines
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed various issues causing minor collision and lighting inconsistencies
[*]Fixed an issue causing biome specific boss traits to not display in the Stage Select menu
[*]Fixed an issue causing cores to flash momentarily when the Core Station is first unlocked

[*]Fixed an issue causing the doors in the Affinity Amplifier unlock room to remain open during combat
[*]Fixed an issue causing homing to affect Thermal Clusterbombs incorrectly
[*]Fixed an issue causing Wrecking Balls to veer upwards after being punched
[*]Fixed an issue causing enemies killed by dash-strike to disappear
[*]Fixed an issue causing no sound to play during Tower liberation in the city

[*]Fixed an issue causing the sound effect of certain weapons to get stuck when opening menus or charging other weapons
[*]Fixed various grammatical issues and typos throughout the game
[/list]

Best,

Hey Shapers!

We're a couple days late on getting this in your hands but The Resilience Update is finally here. We focused on gameplay balancing and improved visuals this time around, tackling some of the common requests that you guys have had on Discord/Steam/Twitter.

[b]Improved Enemy Projectiles[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/e78832c6306d57e943dbc3ac0c7ae142abb41787.gif[/img]

Last update we tweaked a bunch of your guns for gameplay feel and visual quality, and this time we've done the same for enemy bots! Every enemy minion in Battle Shapers now has brand new projectile VFX to improve readability and give the robot hordes a little more personality.

[b]New Hacks: Wrecking Ball and Regenerative Fields[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/274c2827c9dd0042e95ed28ac95d92901fc2a940.gif[/img]

We've added a brand new Shaper Hack to the game, the Wrecking Ball! This hack will spawn several wrecking balls in all the rooms of an entire floor. You can punch these wrecking balls and send them careening into enemy bots, knocking them back and dealing explosion damage. This will also trigger any takedown related effects, so pair this hack up with takedown related core enhancers to make it extra juicy! Regenerative Fields will allow you to health 1 HP per takedown at the end of all fights.

[b]Improved Enemy Density and Enemy Health Rebalancing[/b]

We've received a bunch of feedback that some of our enemy archetypes can feel a bit spongey at times. We've also seen that you guys want more enemies per encounter. We've lowered the HP of every single non-boss enemy in the game. We've also added a system that allows Grunts, Hardhats, Sparkies, Dredgers and Gunner Drones to respawn continuously in combat. This means you'll be killing a lot more robots a lot faster.

[b]Additional HUD Features [/b]

When we were watching people play, we realized almost no one was using the Crimson Repeater as intended right off the bat so we've added a chargeable weapon HUD element around the player's crosshair for all weapons that can be held to charge. The directional damage indicators around the edges of the screen have been upgraded to better show where the hits you're taking are coming from. We've also made substantial improvements to the threat indicators, which will now show display arrows based on how dangerous enemies are and whether or not they are preparing to attack.

notes.title: Community Update - V0.5.0
notes.content:
Howdy Shapers!

We missed you all dearly, and are so happy to be back with our Community Update! As a reminder, this update is built from your suggestions, criticisms, and asks. Thanks for your patience with us as we tried to cover as much ground as possible since we got back from the holidays. As per usual, we’ll be continuing in future updates to improve on FPS drops, balancing, and of course, any other suggestions that may come our way. Without further ado, here are some of the exciting changes we’ve made:

[b]Improved Weapons [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/0f599aa441639cd47659c9fde9d4cddb74cd6e32.gif[/img]

We’ve tweaked our guns! Y’all said the Battering Ram was “mushy”, so we fixed that. We also reduced the reload speed for a ton of heavier weapons like Stormcaller and Quiver. Some of these changes are small and more focused on how they ‘feel’, while some are total reworks of the weapon. Hope the differences smooth your experience and don’t scare you off from using them.

[b]New Goodies [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/8fb6dfc7ae08f55dd7a53eed33329c866fcb54fd.gif[/img]

A cool new ability has joined the arena: Sync Wave! With a large wave of vibro energy, watch as it collapses into itself and lines up your enemies for the perfect shot. No, seriously, It looks like sound waves from certain angles. This is one of my new favourites.

We’ve also added a spicy new weapon: The Firehawk. It’s a throwing axe that sticks to foes and explodes. The longer you charge it the better the explosion, but be careful not to charge it for too long…(or find out for yourself, don’t let me stop you).

[b]Improved New Player Experience [/b]

We made it easier to unlock primary cores, UI indicators to highlight talents, and added a few new cinematics! 

[b]Adding Accessibility [/b]

We added crosshair customization, auto-firing, and our FOV max has been increased to 120. 

[b]Track your Runs! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840536/83647ba53f5382c5f1f4e01aefb149c88118c199.png[/img]

Once you’ve done 10 runs, you’ll unlock a “Battle Log” where you can check out your previous runs! Learn from your mistakes, or flaunt your success!

[b]Changelog V0.5.0[/b]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Quiver has been reworked, this pistol now shoots a large sphere of Vibro energy that damages all enemies along its path. This sphere is considered an explosion for the purposes of Core Enhancer and modifier synergy.
[*]Stormcaller now triggers a larger explosion on its third enemy hit
[*]Tectonic Launcher goes further and now automatically explodes right after piercing through an enemy. Also has had the size of its explosions increased.
[*]Numerous performance optimizations across the game
[*]Multishot has been reworked, it is now compatible with every weapon in the game. You will now be able to stack multiple levels of Multishot on a weapon to get different firing patterns and more projectiles.
[*]Added a new common weapon modifier that grants Multishot 1 for 5 seconds after killing an enemy.
[*]Added a new Uncommon weapon modifier that grants Multishot 1
[*]There is now 1 second of invincibility when using third person abilities (Sonic Boom, Plasma Blast, Falcon Dive, Volt Slam)
[*]Small chests scattered around the levels will now be concentrated at the entrances and exits of each room to reduce time spent looking for them
[*]Burst Fire weapons will now count each burst as one ammo instead of each shot in a burst
[*]Fury now gives 5% increased damage per stack instead of 10%, but is now multiplicative with effects from other sources instead of additive
[*]Fortify now gives 9% damage reduction per stack, down from 10%
[*]Reduced the damage of Strike Mantis’ retaliation by 40%

notes.title: Battle Shapers Upcoming Updates: What's next?
notes.content:
Hi Shapers!

I hope you had a lovely holiday season, we’re back and ready to tell you our next steps!

So, you’re probably wondering “What’s next?”. In the next few days, we’ll be releasing a quick patch (0.4.1) to make some minor improvements to our live version. Then, we’ll move on to our next major update, the Community Update! (0.5.0)

We’re working on improving and changing Battle Shapers according to the feedback YOU have been giving us. Your feedback, as well as what our data suggests, will be dictating the next moves we make. While this isn’t significantly different than our other updates in regards to our intent, as we always try to address issues you bring up, it will take longer than our usual update speed. We want to ensure that this update does right by you, and has enough time to seriously fix and test some of the big issues we see frequently showing up in the feedback you give us.

So, with that being said, here are some examples that we can share of what will be straightened out in our Community update: 

1. [b]Improved Weapons[/b] - tightening swap speeds for all weapons, reducing reload speed on several of our heavier weapons, and increasing effectiveness and damage on some of our less popular weapons.
2. [b]New Goodies[/b] - A new weapon and ability for your enjoyment!
3. [b]Improved New Player Experience[/b] - We’re seeing players take longer than we’d like to unlock primary boss cores and skip over extremely important talents. To compensate, we’re making it easier to unlock primary cores and adding UI indicators to highlight talents that will have a big impact on gameplay. 
4. [b]Buffing 3rd Person Abilities[/b] - Adjusting and scaling damage, and most importantly, adding protection during those 3rd person animations. These abilities require players to undertake a tremendous amount of risk, and we want to make these abilities easier to cast without being punished.
5. [b]Adding Accessibility[/b] - We’ll be adding options for things like auto-fire, as well as improved crosshair visibility.
6. [b]Track your Runs![/b] - We’ll be adding a run history terminal, which is essentially a menu for you to see the results of previously completed runs. We're also adding a run summary screen for successful runs.
7. [b]Rebalancing Enemies[/b] - We’re looking into changing the balance between damage and the number of hits we expect players to take. We’re improving the way enemy bots track player movement and lead their shots and we’ll be adjusting the damage across most enemies to compensate.
8. A lot more smaller changes that we’re super excited for you to get your hands on.

Now more than ever is the time to swing by and say hello in our [url=discord.gg/battleshapers]Discord[/url] and get to know the community and team of our wonderful game. Again, thank you for making this update possible, and can’t wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: Core Affinity Update - V0.4.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8CY5-h7qFhU;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey there Shapers!

Our team is about to take a little holiday break, but we figured before we left, we’d leave you with a little present: another update! 

[h3]New Weapon: Splitshot Kunai[/h3]
The Splitshot Kunai are fast-firing throwing knives that are thrown three at a time. When one hits an enemy, the projectile splits into two to chain to nearby targets allowing you to quickly hit many enemies at once. It also makes you feel like a ninja. Win-win situation.

[h3]New Enemy: Mistmantle[/h3]
Is that…a robo-squid? Nah, it’s the Mistmantle, the latest minion to terrorize New Elysium. Not only do they release hazardous smokescreens that will impair your vision and allow your enemies to hide, they also have GUNS. Stay agile, and try your best to see through the fog!

[h3]New Ability: Nanite Swarm[/h3]
Unleash a swarm of fiery nanobots that inflict hot and intense pyro damage on any enemy. If the enemy is killed while the swarm is attached to them, they’ll seek out a nearby enemy and continue attacking. Good bang for your buck! 

[h3]Extended Core Affinity[/h3]
Using the Affinity Amplifier, the Cores you have acquired can now be upgraded to a fourth and final level of Affinity, giving you access to a dozen brand new, exclusive Duo Core Enhancements. The “Reflective Barrage” core enhancement that was already in game was our first exploration of this system. These special Enhancements are specific to each possible combination of cores you have equipped, so try out each . Here’s the full list below:
[list]
[*][b]Tempestuous Retribution[/b]
Reflected enemy projectiles knockback and slow enemies.
[*][b]Homing Reflect (reassigned) [/b]
Level 1: Reflected enemy projectiles are now Homing
Level 2: All Reflected projectiles are now Homing
[*][b] Fury of the Huntsmaster[/b]
While at maximum Hunter's Mark, any additional Marks gained instead grant 1 Fury.
[*][b]Widespread Carnage[/b]
Level 1: For every different enemy hit by Overkill, increase that Overkill's chance to Crit by 25%.
Level 2: For every different enemy hit by Overkill, increase that Overkill's chance to Crit by 50%.
[*][b]Obliteration[/b]
Overkill deals damage in an explosion
[*][b]Vengeful Winds[/b]
Level 1: While executing the Falcon Dive, Ada reflects incoming enemy projectiles back at them.
Level 2: Any enemy projectile reflected during Falcon Dive grants you 1 Deadeye.
[*][b]Hurricane’s Edge[/b]
Critical Airblades hits grant you Haste.
[*][b]Cyclonic Step[/b]
Wind Step creates a knockback explosion.
[*][b]Aegis of the Voltlord[/b]
When you gain Fortify, spawn an Orb.
[*][b]Thunderous Overload[/b]
Dashing through a Volt Orb triggers its expiration effects and grants you Haste.
[*][b]Lightning Rods[/b]
Level 1 - You have 25% increased chance to Crit against Magnetized enemies.
Level 2 - You have 50% increased chance to Crit against Magnetized enemies.
[/list]
[h3]Recycling is back![/h3]
Due to popular demand, we have brought back the Recycling feature! Now when you have gear that you don’t want to Power Transfer, you can Recycle it to get some extra credits. This should reduce the overall frustration of needing to leave behind weapons and abilities you find during runs.

[h3]Dropping our mixtape[/h3]
And lastly, a heavily requested ask is now a reality…the Battle Shapers’ Original Soundtrack is now available on Steam. Super excited to share that you can now jam out to Battle Shapers’ blazing guitar riffs and heart-pounding boss fight jams outside of the game. Grab it now!

[h3]Other Gameplay Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]All Overlords now have new, tougher attack patterns when they are fought in the third tower of a run
[*]All weapons that have multiple projectiles per shot can now also have additive projectile modifiers. This is part of an ongoing effort to reduce mod incompatibility across the game.
[*]Added a new fighting room to the Hideout
[*]Flinched enemies will not be able to attack for a short duration after being flinched
[*]Duration of Bulwark has been increased from 7 seconds to 8 seconds
[*]The default FOV has been increased from 85 to 95. This change will not apply to players who already have a save file, but can be changed manually in the options menu.
[*]The Combat Shields talent now gives 8 shield points per rank instead of 5.
[*]Reduced the number of modifier slots gear items will spawn with by 1.
[*]The angle at which reflected projectiles will reflect towards enemies has been narrowed but the effective range has been significantly increased. This means your reflected projectiles will not snap sideways as aggressively towards enemies.
[*]Falcon Dive now always takes down exposed enemies.
[*]The size of Deflecting Dash’s hitbox has been increased to better match the visuals
[*]Plasma Blast’s initial explosion base damage has been decreased from 15 to 10, but will now deal 5 damage per tick to enemies standing in its area of effect.
[*]Added sound effects for the Vatkins jumping at you
[*]Added sound effects for the Wind Step ability
[*]Substantial optimization improvements to reduce stuttering in combat
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue causing the laser to stay on if Strike Mantis was slowed during the attack
[*]Fixed an issue causing Vatkins to not be killed after the player clears a challenge or room
[*]Fixed an issue causing the Havoc Hammer to play an unintended animation occasionally when charging
[*]Fixed an issue causing the Plasma Carbine to be unable to shoot switches or chests
[*]Fixed an issue causing enemy attacks to be uninterrupted by knockback effects
[*]Fixed an issue causing Shaper Rift parkour challenges to award one more reward choice than intended
[*]Fixed an issue causing Falcon Dive’s HUD icon to not light up properly when available to use
[*]Fixed an issue causing the edge of Ada’s forearm to be visible when playing at 100 FOV
[*]Fixed an issue causing the Reflective Punch VFX to be stuck on screen if the player triggers a cinematic with the VFX active
[*]Fixed an issue causing Pyronauts to sometimes not use their melee range flamethrower attack
[*]Fixed an issue causing the rotating parts of the Stormscraper to be unaffected by VFXs during the tower liberation cinematic
[/list]
